pages.text: <!doctype html> Home | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Medical and surgical dermatology in Portland Larkfield Dermatology treats skin, hair and nail conditions for adults and children, and removes skin cancers. We are a single-location practice, which means the dermatologist who diagnoses you is the one who treats you and the one who sees you at follow-up. What we treat Skin Cancer Screening Mohs Surgery Acne Treatment Eczema and Psoriasis Laser Resurfacing Cosmetic Injectables Our laser resurfacing programme is designed for immediate improvement in skin texture, and we review the plan with you at every visit. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide. We reserve same-week appointments for changing or bleeding lesions. If something on your skin has changed in the last month, say so when you call and we will fit you in. Book Appointment Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Our Team | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.text: <!doctype html> Our Team | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Our Team Larkfield is a two-dermatologist practice supported by a nurse practitioner and a small clinical team. We deliberately kept the practice small so that continuity is real rather than aspirational. Dr. Priya Raman, MD Dr. Priya Raman, MD is a board-certified dermatologist and fellowship-trained Mohs surgeon. She completed her dermatology residency on the west coast and has practised in Portland for eleven years. Her clinical focus is skin cancer diagnosis, Mohs surgery and complex reconstruction. Dr. Ellis Nakamura, MD Dr. Ellis Nakamura, MD is a board-certified dermatologist who treats inflammatory skin disease in adults and children, including eczema, psoriasis and severe acne. He runs our paediatric clinic on Thursday mornings and reads our practice's pathology alongside the laboratory. Clinical team Our nurse practitioner sees follow-up visits for acne, eczema and psoriasis, and our medical assistants have all worked in dermatology for more than five years. You will usually see the same two or three faces every time you come in, which matters when a condition is being tracked over years rather than weeks. Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Insurance | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.text: <!doctype html> Insurance | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Insurance and Payment Larkfield accepts most major insurance plans, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, United Healthcare, Providence, Moda and Medicare. Medical dermatology visits, skin cancer screening and surgery are covered by most plans. Cosmetic treatments, including injectables and laser resurfacing for cosmetic indications, are not covered by insurance. Prices are published on request and quoted before treatment. We do not offer package deals or discounts tied to booking on the day. We verify your benefits before the visit and tell you your expected cost in advance. If a biopsy is taken, the pathology is billed separately by the laboratory, and we will say so at the time rather than letting a second bill surprise you. Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: FAQ | Larkfield Dermatology
headings: How soon can I be seen for a changing mole?
Will my biopsy leave a scar?
Do you offer cosmetic treatment on the same visit?
pages.text: <!doctype html> FAQ | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Frequently Asked Questions How soon can I be seen for a changing mole? Within the same week. Tell the receptionist that a lesion has changed and you will be triaged into an urgent slot rather than a routine one. Do you see children? Yes. Dr. Nakamura runs a paediatric dermatology clinic on Thursday mornings with longer appointment slots for eczema and birthmark visits. Will my biopsy leave a scar? Any procedure that removes skin leaves a mark. We choose the technique and the placement to make it as inconspicuous as we can, and we tell you what to expect before you consent. How long do results take? Pathology results take about a week. We telephone you with them whatever they show, and we do not leave diagnoses on voicemail. Do you offer cosmetic treatment on the same visit? Not at the first appointment. Cosmetic treatments begin with a consultation so that you have time to consider the plan and the cost before anything is done. Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Skin Cancer Screening | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.description: Full skin examination and mole checks
pages.text: <!doctype html> Skin Cancer Screening | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Skin Cancer Screening A full skin examination takes about twenty minutes and covers the scalp, the spaces between the toes, and everywhere in between. Most of what we find is not cancer. The point of the appointment is to identify the small number of lesions that need a closer look and to give you a baseline against which future changes can be judged. What the procedure involves We use dermoscopy for every suspicious lesion, which lets us see structures below the surface that are invisible to the naked eye. For patients with many moles we photograph the skin so that the next examination is a comparison rather than a fresh assessment from memory. Who it suits If a lesion needs to come off, we usually biopsy it the same day rather than asking you to return. Pathology results take about a week and we telephone you with them whatever they show. Nobody at this practice learns a diagnosis from a letter. Recovery and follow-up How often you should be screened depends on your history. Someone with a previous melanoma, a family history or a great deal of sun exposure may need to be seen twice a year; someone with none of those may not need annual screening at all, and we will say so. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide. Book Appointment Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Mohs Surgery | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.description: Mohs micrographic surgery for skin cancer
pages.text: <!doctype html> Mohs Surgery | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Mohs Surgery Mohs micrographic surgery removes skin cancer in stages, examining each layer under a microscope before deciding whether more tissue needs to come out. Because the margin is checked while you wait, it removes the cancer while sparing more healthy skin than a wide excision would. What the procedure involves It is the technique of choice for cancers on the face, ears, hands and lower legs, for cancers that have come back, and for tumours with indistinct borders. For a small trunk lesion a simple excision is often the better answer, and we will tell you when that is the case. Who it suits Plan for most of the day. The excision itself is quick; the waiting between stages while the tissue is processed is what takes the time. Bring something to read, bring a snack, and bring someone to drive you if the surgery is near your eye. Recovery and follow-up Reconstruction happens the same day once the margins are clear. Our surgeon performs the repair rather than referring it on, and we review the site at one week and again at three months. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide. Book Appointment Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Acne Treatment | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.description: Acne treatment for teenagers and adults
pages.text: <!doctype html> Acne Treatment | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Acne Treatment Acne is a medical condition with effective treatments, not a phase to be waited out. We treat it in teenagers and in adults, and we take adult acne seriously because it behaves differently and responds to different medication than the teenage pattern. What the procedure involves Treatment is matched to the type of acne rather than its severity alone. Comedonal acne, inflammatory acne and nodular acne need different approaches, and hormonal patterns in adult women often respond to treatments that do nothing for a fifteen year old with the same score on paper. Who it suits Most treatments take eight to twelve weeks to show their full effect, which is the single most common reason people abandon a plan that was working. We book the review at the eight week mark when we start, so the check-in is already in the diary. Recovery and follow-up For severe or scarring acne we discuss isotretinoin. It is a highly effective medication with monitoring requirements and important precautions, all of which we go through in detail before anyone starts it. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide. Book Appointment Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Eczema and Psoriasis | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.text: <!doctype html> Eczema and Psoriasis | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Eczema and Psoriasis Eczema and psoriasis are long-term inflammatory conditions. Neither is cured by a single prescription, and both are far more controllable than most people arriving at our clinic have been led to believe. The goal we set with you is clear skin most of the time, not a temporary improvement. What the procedure involves For eczema, treatment starts with getting the barrier working: the right emollient used often enough, topical anti-inflammatories used correctly during flares, and identifying the triggers that matter for you specifically rather than the generic list. Who it suits For moderate to severe disease that topical treatment cannot hold, we use phototherapy, systemic medication and biologics. Biologic therapy has changed what is achievable in psoriasis in particular, and we handle the insurance authorisation for it in-house. Recovery and follow-up Children with eczema are seen in our Thursday clinic with longer appointment slots, because teaching a family how and when to apply treatment takes more than ten minutes and is the part that determines whether it works. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide. Book Appointment Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Laser Resurfacing | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.description: Laser resurfacing for sun damage and scarring
pages.text: <!doctype html> Laser Resurfacing | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Laser Resurfacing Laser resurfacing removes damaged outer layers of skin in a controlled way so that smoother skin grows in their place. We use it for sun damage, fine lines, uneven pigment and some scarring. What the procedure involves We use both ablative and non-ablative lasers and the choice is a trade-off. Ablative resurfacing achieves more in one session and requires a week or more of visible healing. Non-ablative treatment requires a course of sessions and lets you return to work the next day. Who it suits Preparation matters more than people expect. Skin is prepared for several weeks beforehand, sun exposure has to be avoided before and after, and patients with a history of cold sores are given antiviral medication in advance. Recovery and follow-up Healing follows a predictable course: redness and swelling for the first few days, peeling through the first week, and a pink phase that fades over several weeks. Sun protection afterwards is not optional; it determines whether the result holds. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide. Book Appointment Larkfield Dermatology 1455 Southwest Alder Street, Portland, OR 97205 Phone: (503) 555-0172 Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

pages.title: Cosmetic Injectables | Larkfield Dermatology
pages.text: <!doctype html> Cosmetic Injectables | Larkfield Dermatology Home Services Our Team Insurance FAQ Reviews Contact Cosmetic Injectables Cosmetic injectable treatments are performed by our dermatologists rather than delegated. That is a deliberate choice: the anatomy that makes these treatments safe is the same anatomy we work with in surgical dermatology. What the procedure involves Botulinum toxin softens the lines produced by muscle movement, principally across the forehead and around the eyes. The effect develops over about two weeks and lasts three to four months. Dermal fillers restore volume where fat has been lost and are used along the cheeks, temples and jawline. Who it suits The first appointment is a consultation, not a treatment. We look at your face at rest and moving, explain which of your concerns these treatments can and cannot address, and quote you before anything is booked. Some people leave that appointment having decided not to proceed, which is a perfectly good outcome. Recovery and follow-up We review every patient two weeks after their first treatment, at no charge, to assess the effect and adjust the plan for next time. Individual results vary, and every treatment on this page carries risks and limitations that we discuss with you before you decide.
